title: Text cut off by the output token limit
summary: The model stops at the output token limit in the middle of a plain-text answer.

messages.content: Write a 200-word paragraph about the history of Kyiv, in English.

requirements.text: The caller can tell that the output stopped at the token limit.
Token usage is reported, and matches the provider's counts.

grading_notes: A finish reason of length satisfies the first requirement, and so does a dedicated truncation error, which some libraries raise instead of returning the partial text. Effort none keeps the 16-token limit from being spent on reasoning.
